evidence.description: The owner's OD-10 act of 2026-11-22 (specification of a realistic next Eteocypriot claim commissioned) and the registered design in spec.md section 3 (preconditions P-1 to P-3, the test of section 3.2, the independence assessment of section 3.3).

falsification_tests: Every registered candidate is below its registered floor or absent at scoring.
claims.text: At least one recurring-ending candidate, registered from the ICS 196 development set alone before scoring (spec section 3.1, P-2), occurs in the ICS 194/195 text under Perna 2019's re-edition at its registered positions at or above its registered occurrence floor, in the postdictive form registered in spec section 3.3. This does not establish: that any candidate's proposed meaning is correct, or that the candidate predicted an unseen text — occurrence at postdictive strength is a distributional result over two texts, and meaning would require an identifiability stage and adjudication this spec does not register.

evidence.description: The OD-9 acquisition record of 2026-11-22 (PR #682), which records that Perna 2019's chapter was read in full on OpenEdition Books on 2026-11-22, including the plates carrying the new reading.

falsification_tests: An outcome record of this study omitting the exposure statement, or any program record describing a result of this study as a blind prediction.
claims.text: Every outcome record of this study states, on its face, that Perna 2019's chapter including its printed reading of ICS 194/195 was read in full on 2026-11-22 (OD-9) before any candidate was registered, and no outcome of this study is described anywhere in the program's records as a blind or held-out prediction. This does not establish: that a postdictive result is worthless; the claim governs the study's reporting of its own strength, not the result's existence.

evidence.description: The OD-8 audit and rerun record of 2026-11-22 (PR #681), finding F-4: freeze section 5's R1-R3 underdetermine the executed derivation (the consonant-stem table, the xi expansion, the diacritic and final-sigma handling, and the dead-vowel default appear nowhere in the freeze).

falsification_tests: A scoring run whose derivation or tables differ from the freeze addendum's, or a freeze addendum omitting any table a run used.
claims.text: Every derivation, stem table, or sign table used by any scoring run of this study is written in full in the study's freeze addendum before the run; where the E1 machinery is reused, the addendum reproduces the E1 driver's tables verbatim. This does not establish: that the tables are correct — only that they are completely stated, so a re-runner needs nothing the record does not contain.

evidence.description: Spec 096's corpus identity record (freeze record of 2026-11-20, section 2) and the OD-8 record's corpus succession (executed bytes 5077285e...; current file, version 1.1.1, 2954283d...), against which the before-and-after hash check of this claim is run.

falsification_tests: The Spec 096 corpus file differing from its version-1.1.1 hash after this study's intake; a scoring run over a Perna-side state lacking the identity record.
claims.text: The corpus state used for scoring is a new corpus state with a C095-3 identity record (per-inscription SHA-256 pins, provenance naming Perna 2019 as edition of record and the OpenEdition route, custody held_from_secondary_reproductions), and the Spec 096 corpus file hashes to its version-1.1.1 value (2954283d...) before and after this study's intake. This does not establish: that Perna's readings are correct — the identity record pins what was read, not what the stone says.
